scenario: Golden vector AF-2 (specs/conformance/SERIES_SIGNAL_VECTORS.md), read by a rule: a stuck-true sensor (true at 0, no falling edge) on `active_fraction sliding 1_min`, read at 60 s, is 1.0. The open interval is clipped to the query time and covers the whole window (LSIG.2.2.3): the query-time open-interval extrapolation, reached here by a rule firing 60 s after the only sample. At 60 s a `Probe` arrives and `read` logs the binding's `active_fraction` ([NSBK.6.3]).
rules_ds:
use default

schema Pump scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Bool mutable

schema Probe scope explicit:
    k: Int

series Pump.state:
    active_fraction sliding 1_min

rule read:
    Probe
    Pump p
->
    log info "{p.active_fraction}"
